fear_greed.note: Recovering from extreme fear—7 straight days below 30. The floor might be forming.

market_pulse: Okay so—market is still deep in fear territory but something shifted. ETH just posted a 3.4% day while everything else limped along, and Strategy keeps stacking BTC like they know something we don't. The sentiment composite from the analysis system reads 17—extreme fear—but the Fear & Greed is crawling up from 15 to 28 over the week. That's not a reversal yet, but it's the first time in 7 days the number went up instead of down. Reddit is full of capitulation stories—some whale held out 8 months then panic-sold, a guy lost $1M in 10 minutes. Classic bottom signals, or at least the kind of pain that usually precedes one.
